summary: solana-web3-community 1.0.5: suspicious patterns require human review
details: Package name resembles the established Solana JavaScript SDK family. The bundled outputs lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js contain co-occurrences of require('child_process'), fetch/POST/GET calls, and shell-tool tokens (curl, ping) within a minified bundle. These patterns can match either an exfiltration/dropper composition or routine SDK behavior (HTTP RPC client + helper utilities) bundled into a single file; the keyword adjacency in minified output is not by itself conclusive. Detailed semantic tracing of the flagged code paths did not complete, so intent cannot be confirmed from the available evidence. Routing to human review to confirm whether the network calls and child_process usage at the cited lines correspond to documented SDK functionality or to hardcoded attacker-controlled destinations / install-time execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
